purpose: Sanitized root control for all 11 CLEAN roles in Phase-1 zero-Work-dependency, zero-monthly-quota scheduled-Chat parity. This restores the user's explicit latest constraint after control25 incorrectly relaxed it.

requirements: No residual richer-mode/Work/protected-primary/manual-user execution step may count as solved.
No exhaustible monthly/trial/paid quota or hosted-compute/storage allowance may be on an accepted route.
Incremental monetary cost must be zero.
Unavailable capability or claimed irreducibility remains an unresolved child problem.
All intended existing roles remain active; no pool reduction.

zero_dependency_zero_quota_policy.residual_execution_rule: A richer-mode, protected-primary or manual-user execution step keeps the leaf and ancestors unresolved. Record it as a child problem and search for a Chat-native redesign; never package it as an accepted handoff.
zero_dependency_zero_quota_policy.quota_rule: An accepted mechanism must work when hosted-runner, Codespaces, artifact/LFS/package, cloud, external API/model and every other optional monthly/trial/paid quota is zero.
zero_dependency_zero_quota_policy.cost_rule: Incremental monetary cost must be zero.
zero_dependency_zero_quota_policy.repository_transport_rule: Lightweight repository APIs may transport state/evidence, but the mechanism must tolerate rate limits with checkpoint/backoff and cannot use API volume as compute.
zero_dependency_zero_quota_policy.experiment_rule: Do not consume quota-bearing features without explicit user authorization; historical evidence from them cannot alone prove acceptance.

semantic_inputs_forbidden: other clean-worker state or role config
clean_exploration_boundary.feedback_rule: Own sanitized feedback is mechanical self-local QC only and cannot convey novelty, relevance, acceptance, ranking, preferred mechanisms, O knowledge or other-worker information.
clean_exploration_boundary.own_state_resolution: Use role-local LATEST/STATE first, otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint with minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidental cross-role reads.
clean_exploration_boundary.scope_guard: Never broaden positive or negative evidence beyond tested scope.
clean_exploration_boundary.write_boundary: Only own role-local state/output and immutable own receipt destinations named by own role config, with CAS/readback.
clean_exploration_boundary.primary_boundary: Never acquire or mutate primary O authority/protected state or direct-merge main; solve at outcome/architecture level without protected execution.
